summary: Read an array cost of nonnegative integers. Its length is from 2 to 1000, and every entry is an integer from 0 through 999. Paying the value at index i lets you step onto stair i. After that payment you may move up either one stair or two stairs. You may start at index 0 or at index 1, and the stair where you start must be paid too. The top of the staircase lies just beyond the final index. Find the smallest total payment that reaches the top and write it.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
